messages:
mira: quick async pulse from me — AsteriaPay renewal flagged a webhook retry storm overnight. what I did: triaged their crash-looping webhook, opened ticket `CS-823`, collected sample request IDs and logs, escalated to eng. blocker: still not sure whether the 504s are from our gateway or their infra (NAT timeouts). today: need eng confirmation on retry semantics + temp rate-limit plan, and a short note for renewal team before the call. ping @jordan for log dives :wave:
jordan: I can take a look in ~10. saw a handful of 504s around 03:12 that match a burst of retries. can you paste 1-2 request IDs? also did you see any proxy-side errors in the traces?
mira: sending sample IDs now:
```
req_20260317_A1b2c3
req_20260317_A1b2c8
req_20260317_A1b2f0
```
there's a snippet from their side too — they had repeated 3xx-5xx over a 90s window. no clear trace span linking to our retry middleware yet.
jordan: thanks — pulling gateway logs for those IDs. initial quick grep shows connection reset on upstream for two of them, and one looks like 504 from our edge after 30s timeout. will confirm if our retry layer retriggered requests.
sara: heads-up — AsteriaPay renewal call is tomorrow 11:00am PT. finance asked for an incident summary if this is customer-facing. can we have a 1-paragraph for the renewal owner by EOD? :clipboard:
lee: on the renewal note — we should include mitigation steps and next steps (config change + follow-up). I can draft the blurb once eng confirms root cause.
jordan: quick update — looks like gateway circuit limit hit during a short spike, causing queued requests >30s and our edge returned 504s. their client retried aggressively which amplified the spike. plan: bump per-customer concurrent dial limit on the gateway and add short-term per-route concurrency cap + slow-start backpressure. I'll put a PR up for the config change and a hotfix to metrics alerts.
mira: solid. can you add a canary route for AsteriaPay (route-id `asteria-canary`) so we can test without touching global config? also please include rollback steps.
jordan: yep. creating PR now: `platform/gateway#482` — includes: bump limit, per-route cap, added backpressure header and an env toggle. will request review from @lee. aiming to deploy canary to prod region us-west-2 in the next 2 hrs.
deploy-bot: deploy platform/gateway#482 to us-west-2 started by jordan — canary toggle enabled.
mira: thanks all. blockers for me: need the one-paragraph summary for renewal (sara), and confirmation when canary is live so I can notify AM.
sara: I'll draft the paragraph once jordan confirms canary live. should be 3-4 lines: cause, mitigations, customer-facing next steps.
jordan: canary live in us-west-2. initial telemetry looks good — retries down, P50 latency unchanged, P95 improved. pushing full rollout after a short observation window (~20m).
mira: excellent — adding to the renewal owner ticket and will update them. post-deploy checklist: 
- update `CS-823` with link to PR and deploy
- schedule 15m sync if any regression shows up
- send renewal note by 5pm PT
thanks team :heart:
lee: I'll help with the renewal call prep slides after you post the summary.
mira: done for now. will follow up with a single-line incident note in the ticket and ping here if anything flips.
jordan: closing loop — will watch alerts for the next 2 hrs and escalate if needed.
sara: thx everyone — I'll be on the renewal call tomorrow and have the note ready if nothing regresses.
mira: closing this async check-in. open items: add summary to renewal ticket, confirm full rollout, postmortem if required.
